verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a government agency with an open-data program and EDI filing could publish an API spec. However, the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger document at any candidate path. The keyless Socrata SODA query on data.texas.gov returns JSON rows, but that is a host-platform data endpoint, not a downloadable machine-readable API specification from the Comptroller.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
